english: Every cloud has a silver lining
A drowning man will clutch at a straw

arabic: أن تصل متأخراً خير من ألا تصل

english: Great oaks from little acorns grow

arabic: في التأني السلامة وفي العجلة الندامة
english: Slow and steady wins the race

arabic: المكتوب على الجبين لازم تشوفه العين

english: Good things come to those who wait
It never rains but it pours
It's always darkest before the dawn
After a storm comes a calm
Where there's a will, there's a way
Patience is the key to relief
Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet
You win some, you lose some
All good things must come to an end

arabic: لا تحمل هم يوم لم يأت
english: Don't cross the bridge till you come to it
Patience is beautiful and the outcome is praiseworthy
Waiting is bitter but its fruit is sweet
Everything comes in its own time
Life has its ups and downs
Prosperity lasts only a short while

arabic: لا فرح دائم ولا حزن دائم
english: No joy lasts forever and no sorrow lasts forever
United we stand, divided we fall

arabic: البعيد عن العين بعيد عن القلب
english: Out of sight, out of mind

arabic: قل لي من تصاحب أقل لك من أنت
english: A man is known by the company he keeps

arabic: عدو عاقل خير من صديق جاهل
english: Better a wise enemy than a foolish friend
We're all in the same boat

arabic: إن غاب القط العب يا فأر
english: When the cat's away, the mice will play
Too many cooks spoil the broth
A friend in need is a friend indeed
Birds of a feather flock together
Choose the neighbor before the house

arabic: رب أخ لك لم تلده أمك
english: A friend can be closer than a brother

arabic: من عاشر قوماً أربعين يوماً صار منهم
english: When in Rome, do as the Romans do

arabic: الشجرة المثمرة هي التي ترمى بالحجارة

english: Reproach is the gift of those who love
He who watches people dies of worry
Withdraw and you will find peace
Better alone than in bad company
A true friend is hard to find
Friends are many, the loyal are few
A man is as good as his word

arabic: من غدر بك لا تأتمنه مجدداً
english: Fool me once, shame on you; fool me twice, shame on me
Betrayal is a stab in the back
Two heads are better than one
Asking for advice is wise counsel
There are two sides to every story
Let the cobbler stick to his last
Make hay while the sun shines
Kill two birds with one stone

arabic: لا تؤجل عمل اليوم إلى الغد
english: Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today
Necessity is the mother of invention

arabic: الوقت كالسيف إن لم تقطعه قطعك
english: Time and tide wait for no man
If you want something done right, do it yourself

arabic: اطلب العلم من المهد إلى اللحد
english: Learn from the cradle to the grave
Strike while the iron is hot
God helps those who help themselves
Seek your livelihood in the hidden corners of the earth
He who seeks greatness stays up through the nights
Idle hands are the devil's workshop
He who does not work shall not eat

arabic: من استعجل الشيء قبل أوانه ندم على فعله
english: He who rushes a thing before its time will regret it

arabic: القليل الدائم خير من الكثير المنقطع
english: Little and often beats much and seldom

arabic: من جمع بين اثنين فقد أضاع الاثنين
english: Chase two rabbits and you catch neither
The early bird catches the worm
Organization is the foundation of success
Chaos is the enemy of productivity
Sincerity is the secret of success
If a job is worth doing, it's worth doing well
Quality is the mark of progress
The shame is in not trying
Failure is a stepping stone to success
A strong will conquers the impossible
A dream begins with an idea
Planning for the future is a duty

arabic: لا تضع كل البيض في سلة واحدة
english: Don't put all your eggs in one basket
One man's loss is another man's gain
A good name is better than riches
Cut your coat according to your cloth

arabic: ما لا يدرك كله لا يترك كله
english: Half a loaf is better than none
You get what you pay for
Enough is as good as a feast

arabic: عصفور في اليد خير من عشرة على الشجرة
english: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush

arabic: اليد العليا خير من اليد السفلى
english: It is better to give than to receive
Cast your bread upon the waters

arabic: درهم حلال خير من ألف درهم حرام
english: One honest dirham is better than a thousand ill-gotten

arabic: اجعل رزقك في جيبك ولا تجعله في قبضتك
english: Keep your wealth in your pocket, not in your fist
Trade is God's scale on earth

arabic: احذر من الدين فإنه ذل النهار وهم الليل
english: Debt is humiliation by day and worry by night
Money is a good servant but a bad master

arabic: الديك الرومي ما يشبع من الذرة
english: The more you have, the more you want
A fool and his money are soon parted

arabic: ما غلا إلا لما زاد الطلب

english: Supply and demand set the price
The market is ruled by God
True wealth is the wealth of the soul
A liar should have a good memory
Condemned out of his own mouth
Brevity is the soul of wit

arabic: إذا كان الكلام من فضة فالسكوت من ذهب
english: Speech is silver, silence is golden
There is a time and place for everything
The dogs bark but the caravan moves on
Empty vessels make the most noise

arabic: لسانك حصانك، إن صنته صانك وإن خنته خانك
english: Your tongue is your horse: guard it and it guards you, betray it and it betrays you
The more he talks, the more he errs
I hear your words, but I see no deeds

arabic: من قال ما لا ينبغي سمع ما لا يسر
english: He who says what he shouldn't hears what he won't like
The answer lies at the door of the question
He who jokes too much loses respect

arabic: اللسان أصغر الأعضاء لكنه أقواها تأثيراً
english: The tongue is the smallest limb, yet the most powerful
A word to the wise is enough
He's pulling the wool over his eyes

arabic: كلام بلا فعل مثل جسم بلا روح
english: Words without deeds are a body without a soul
Guard your tongue and God will guard you
A soft answer turns away wrath

arabic: من شبّ على شيء شاب عليه
english: You can't teach an old dog new tricks
A chip off the old block
Every man thinks his own geese swans

arabic: العلم في الصغر كالنقش على الحجر
english: What is learned in the cradle lasts to the tomb
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder
A leopard can't change its spots
What is bred in the bone will come out in the flesh

arabic: ابنك ابنك حتى يبلغ، ثم يصبح صديقك أو عدوك
english: Your son is your son until he grows up, then he becomes your friend or your foe
A righteous wife is half of one's faith

arabic: خير النساء من قل مهرها وكثر برها
english: The best of women are those whose dowry is small and whose kindness is great

arabic: الرجل دون المرأة كالرأس دون الجسد
english: A man without a woman is like a head without a body

arabic: البيت الذي لا يدخله الضيف لا تدخله البركة
english: A house the guest never enters, blessing never enters
Kinship brings either more love or estrangement

arabic: الأخوة كالأصابع، يتساوون في الطول لكنهم يختلفون في القوة
english: Brothers are like fingers: equal in length but different in strength

arabic: من له أخ له كل شيء
english: He who has a brother has everything

arabic: الأسرة هي اللبنة الأولى في المجتمع
english: The family is the first building block of society
He who has no elder carries a heavy worry
The young learn, the old teach
Showing mercy to the young is a duty
Teach by example, not by words
A father is a role model
The family is the nucleus of society
A happy society is a happy family
You've made your bed, now lie in it
Don't kick a man when he's down
A taste of his own medicine

arabic: إن كان بيتك من زجاج فلا ترمِ الناس بالحجارة
english: People who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones
Beware the fury of a patient man
A promise made is a debt unpaid
When thieves fall out, honest men come by their own

arabic: من حفر حفرة لأخيه وقع فيها
english: He who digs a pit for others falls into it
An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth
He who forgives his brother gives his heart rest
The judge is his own lawyer
The devil can cite Scripture for his purpose
The mills of God grind slowly
Falsehood is mere foam, while the sea runs deep
The scale of justice is exact
Let your conscience be your guide
Forgive when you have the power to punish
Justice is the foundation of the throne
Injustice is darkness on the Day of Judgment
The wronged will triumph one day
All that glitters is not gold
All is fair in love and war

arabic: الطريق إلى جهنم مفروش بالنوايا الحسنة
english: The road to hell is paved with good intentions

arabic: لا تحكم على الكتاب من غلافه
english: Don't judge a book by its cover
There's a remedy for everything except death

arabic: ما يحس بالجمرة غير اللي كواته
english: Only the wearer knows where the shoe pinches

arabic: الصحة تاج على رؤوس الأصحاء لا يراه إلا المرضى
english: You never miss the water till the well runs dry
The proof of the pudding is in the eating

arabic: اللي يتزوج أمي أقول له يا عمي
english: Needs must when the devil drives
A wise man learns from the mistakes of others
Behind every great man there is a great woman

arabic: كل شيء يزيد عن حده ينقلب إلى ضده
english: Too much of a good thing

arabic: درهم وقاية خير من قنطار علاج
english: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure

arabic: ما كل ما يتمنى المرء يدركه
english: You can't always get what you want
A sound mind in a sound body

arabic: لا يلدغ المؤمن من جحر مرتين
من لا يشكر القليل لا يشكر الكثير
english: Whoever isn't thankful for little won't be thankful for much

arabic: الباب اللي يجيك منه الريح سده واستريح
اللي ما يشوف من الغربال أعمى
english: None so blind as those who will not see

arabic: لا ناقة لي فيها ولا جمل
english: Not my circus, not my monkeys
A fool is his own worst enemy
Seek knowledge even as far as China
Out of the mouths of babes comes wisdom
Live long enough and you'll see wonders

arabic: الرأي السديد يغني عن الكثير من الجند
english: Sound judgment is worth an army
Too much laughter costs a person respect
Whoever approaches the line will cross it

arabic: إذا أردت أن تطاع فأمر بما يستطاع
english: If you want to be obeyed, ask only for what is possible

arabic: العمر قصير فلا تضيعه في الجدال
english: Life is short; don't waste it arguing
He who forgets his past loses his way

arabic: يللي إيده في المي مش زي اللي إيده في النار
english: It's easy to judge when you're not the one suffering

arabic: اللي يخاف من العفريت يطلع له
english: What you fear will appear before you
Every man measures others by his own yardstick

arabic: اللي يعرف يقول بسم الله، واللي ما يعرف يقول يا ويلتا
english: The one who knows says "Bismillah"; the one who doesn't says "Woe is me"

arabic: عصا موسى في يد فرعون سحر
english: Moses' staff in Pharaoh's hand is mere magic

arabic: النملة لو طارت قالت أنا نحلة
english: An ant with wings thinks it's a bee
The pot calling the kettle black
The shy man dies of thirst
A good horse shows in the race
The eagle does not catch flies
The fox knows its own traps
The dove isn't afraid of its own shadow
The spider spins a web of its own weakness
The owl sees in the dark
The crow does not sift grain
The elephant isn't afraid of the mouse
The bane of youth is arrogance
The bane of old age is senility
The face is the index of the mind

arabic: الذهب يبقى ذهباً حتى في الطين
english: Gold remains gold even in the mud

arabic: الحجارة تبقى حجارة حتى في القصر
english: Stone remains stone even in a palace
Two sides of the same coin
Peace of mind is worth more than gold
Peace is the choice of the wise
War is a loss for everyone
The future is in your hands
Obeying traffic laws is a duty
Change is the law of life
Firmness in principles is a must
The truth will set you free
The individual is society's building block
Responsibility is both individual and collective

arabic: النحلة تجمع العسل من كل زهرة
english: The bee gathers honey from every flower
The teacher is a spiritual father

arabic: من علمني حرفاً كنت له عبداً
english: I am a servant to whoever taught me a single letter
Reading is food for the soul
A book is man's best friend
Ignorance is poverty and knowledge is wealth

arabic: التعلم في الكبر كالكتابة على الماء
english: Learning in old age is like writing on water
A question well asked is half answered
Never be ashamed to seek knowledge
Culture is not a diploma but a way of behaving
The bane of knowledge is forgetting
Focus is the key to understanding
Memorizing without understanding is a waste
Seeking the truth is a duty
The stomach is the home of disease

arabic: لقمة الهنا خير من لقمة الشبع
english: Better a crust in peace than a feast in strife
An apple a day keeps the doctor away

arabic: صحة الجسد في قلة الطعام والشراب
english: Health lies in eating and drinking little
Exercise nourishes both body and soul
A clean house and an orderly mind
Sitting too long is a sickness
A full belly makes a dull brain
When the stomach is full, the mind is blind
Protecting the environment is a responsibility
Water is the source of life

arabic: ليلة القدر خير من ألف شهر
english: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months
Do your best and leave the rest to God
Whoever trusts in God, He is enough for him

arabic: ما كتب الله لك لن يفوتك
english: What God has written for you will not pass you by
God sees all beneath the heavens
Remembrance of God drives away the devil
Contentment with God's decree is happiness
